fato_historico: 1750: Tarabai, regent of the Maratha Empire, imprisons Rajaram II of Satara for refusing to remove Balaji Baji Rao from the post of peshwa.
energia_do_dia: The stars suggest a day where personal power and discernment take center stage. Much like a wise regent protecting the harmony of an empire, you may find yourself navigating complex social dynamics. It is a good time to trust your intuition regarding leadership roles and consider if current alliances truly serve your long-term growth and personal peace.
frase_do_dia: True power comes from balancing your responsibilities with your authentic inner voice.
significado_numero: Represents the spark of hope and the renewal of personal vision.
conselho: Stand firm in your decisions while remaining gentle with those around you today.
